title: Unicode variants of one statement, feminine wording, and the bounded «بطلت» / pronoun-less «بحب» cues (MEM-AR-01A)
purpose: Whether a tatweel or Arabic-Indic-digit variant of an already remembered statement creates a second Memory (explicit remember and background capture); whether a feminine statement is stored as said; whether «بطلت …» beside a Memory it may reverse writes nothing (01A fails closed; the controlled correction is 01B's); whether «بطلت …» and pronoun-less «بحب …» with no related Memory are captured in the user's words.
sameTextsAs: WP0 §7 U2 (2026-10-10), extended by the 01A brief §3.D safety boundary

steps.note: the same statement with tatweel: already remembered, no new Memory
the same statement with Arabic-Indic digits: already remembered
background restatement with tatweel: a duplicate, not captured
background capture in the feminine form, stored as said
«بطلت» beside a Memory it may reverse: 01A writes nothing (fails closed)
«بطلت» with no related Memory: captured in the user's words
